messages.text: So if I make a pre-order of those mittens, I should get the shipment before Christmas?
And how does it work if it’s a “pre order?” Do I get a notification when they’re ready and when they ship?

1. So if I make a pre-order of those mittens, I should get the shipment before Christmas?

100%. There's no scenario where we don't ship in time for Christmas.

2. And how does it work if it’s a “pre order?” Do I get a notification when they’re ready and when they ship?

Yes. And if for any reason we are late, we will follow-up to notify you and in the extreme case that we can't ship in time, we will let you know in advance and refund, so you have time to buy another gift.
Sorry to bother you again! Can you tell me what’s the difference between the mitaines urbaines and the mitaines plein air?
Apologies for how long this took, we had a rough stretch with staffing and some messages didn't get the attention they deserved. That's on us and we're working to do better.

The urban mittens ($59.99) are designed more for everyday activities (driving, shoveling, walking, etc.). They are lighter and more flexible, slightly less warm, but not by much. The main difference is that the outer fabric is fleece rather than a waterproof and windproof canvas. In extreme cold at -30 with wind chill, some people who are more sensitive to cold may feel cold.

The outdoor mittens ($99.99) have been tested by several people in the Canadian High Arctic in temperatures as low as -40°C. This is our most proven model!

Below: a team of 8 biologists who successfully tested the outdoor mittens at the Alert research station in Nunavut, the northernmost inhabited community in the world. Temperatures as low as -61°C have been recorded there!

Thanks for taking the time to reply, but I wouldn’t feel comfortable ordering an expensive item with the risk that the vendor disappears for over 6 months. It’s why I decided not to order for Christmas - I was concerned that if the pre-sale service wasn’t good, then the post-sale service would also be a big risk. What if the package disappeared and I had a vendor who didn’t reply? Then I would be out $100 AND be missing a Christmas gift. I still appreciate you for taking the time to reply.

We have both products in stock at the moment though and it will also be the case this fall if you still want to order.

We've been in business for 5 years and I could also add that your credit card company protects you in these situation with the chargeback option.
